front.title: Bundle Transfer Protocol - Unidirectional (BTPU) over Ethernet

abstract.t: This document specifies the use of the Bundle Transfer Protocol - Unidirectional (BTPU) as a Convergence Layer directly over Ethernet, and requests allocation of an EtherType and a multicast MAC address for that purpose. This provides an alternative to IP-based convergence layers for environments where Ethernet forwarding is operationally feasible but IP routing is unavailable or operationally undesirable.
